configurationIssues: MEDIA_STORAGE_ADAPTER must be explicitly set to s3 in deployed runtime.
MEDIA_UPLOAD_TOKEN_SECRET must be present, non-placeholder, and at least 32 characters.
Hosted runtime requires explicit APP_ENV and NODE_ENV=production.
A full 40-character BUILD_SHA or provider commit SHA is required.
AWS_S3_BUCKET must equal S3_BUCKET_NAME for mounted video/media paths.
Private billing proof requires dedicated scoped AWS credentials.
Set SAVED_SEARCH_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false, or true with a strong token secret.
